conviction_note: Full-year print with the first FY27 guide and the FY27 dividend due in the same 15:30 batch, under a Murakami-family holder (12.35%, stated aim: higher dividend, buybacks or going private) and a platinum cost that fell ~25-30% from H1 levels after an April price rise; the FY26 year itself is guided 'in line' and sits slightly under a stale IFIS number, so the lean is modest (p_up 60) on a name that has moved a median 6.6% on its last five prints.
bar: IFIS consensus FY26 (Aug) revenue 31,000 / OP 3,800 / pretax 3,400 / NP 2,300 (JPY m), unchanged for 4 weeks, likely 1 analyst: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=367A ; company plan 30,000 / 3,650 / 3,200 / 2,170 (unchanged since 2025-10-15, reaffirmed 2026-07-15 as 'ガイダンス通りに着地予定'). FY27 consensus not found. Bar is a single estimate source plus the company guide, so the reported-quarter finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5% (0.0%, unchanged, as of 2026-10-14, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). kabutan: 367A is a 制度信用 buy-only name (no margin shorting), 信用倍率 not computable (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=367A). No skew (no options). So there is no short fuel and no crowded short; the identifiable incremental buyer is the Murakami group (MI2 + 村上貴輝), 0% -> 12.35% between 2026-04-15 and 2026-09-14. Run-up 20d +2.41%, 5d -0.87%, priced_lean -0.12.

findings.finding: Capital-return pressure into the FY print: MI2 and 村上貴輝 (Murakami family) built 12.35% from April to September 2026 with a filed purpose of proposing 増配, 自己株式取得 or 非公開化; the company already expanded its 株主優待 at the Q3 print (2026-07-15), and upstreamed JPY 2.0bn cash from Primo Japan to the parent in May-Aug 2026 (500m, 500m, and 1,000m on 2026-08-17 paid out of capital surplus) against roughly JPY 1.05bn a year of dividends, so the FY27 dividend guide and a possible buyback announced in the same batch are the likeliest positive addition.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-07-15 Q3 print came with a 配当予想の修正 (95 -> 105 yen) and the stock rose 11.41% next session (baseline history; disclosure listed at https://irbank.net/367A/ir). 2026-07-15 Q3 print with the 優待 expansion still fell 5.15% on the margin drop, so returns alone did not offset a weak quarter. 2026-09-25: +4.95% on the MI2 stake increase report.
findings.why_not_priced: The stake is public and the stock is up from ~2,600 (late July) to 2,845, but at PER ~11.5x and a 4.1-4.2% yield with no analyst target (kabuyoho shows 0 ratings), the price is not carrying a buyback or a payout step-up. If it were, the yield would be compressed toward peers and the 9/25 jump would not have been followed by a flat three weeks. Whether the company acts is decided at this release, not before.
findings.independence: The cash upstreaming is a separate set of company documents: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260817/140120260817521558.pdf (1,000m), the 2026-09-15 correction stating it was paid from その他資本剰余金 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260915/140120260915536586.pdf, and the 500m notices of 2026-05-14 and 2026-07-14. The 優待 expansion: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594094.pdf. Holder purpose text also in the EDINET change report summarised at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=367A&b=n202609240938. Inference: the cash build could also go to debt repayment, which the company lists beside returns in its cash-allocation slide.

findings.finding: Margin recovery into Q4 and the FY27 guide: the Q3 gross margin trough (57.5%, down 7.2pt) was blamed on pre-April pricing and high-cost precious metal; the company guided Q4 GP margin 60-62% and sources after order, while Tanaka-based platinum prices fell from 8,600-12,300 yen/g in Jan-Mar to 7,100-8,400 in Jun-Sep 2026, so the first FY27 guide should carry a margin rebound on top of 11-16% revenue growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-15 FY25 print with the first FY26 guide (OP +16.5%) rose 6.63% next session; 2026-07-16 the margin miss took it down 5.15% (baseline history; release times 15:30 per https://irbank.net/367A/ir).
findings.why_not_priced: Platinum prices are public, but the transmission into a made-to-order jeweller's FY27 guide is only visible in the guide itself; IFIS consensus has not moved in 4 weeks and covers FY26 only, so no FY27 number is anchoring the price. If the margin rebound were priced the stock would have recovered its pre-Q3 level with a higher multiple, not traded at ~11.5x the FY26 plan.
findings.independence: Platinum series from a different source: https://komehyo.jp/kaitori/gold/platinum/souba/2026/ (year high 12,306 on 1/26, low 7,076 on 6/27). Counterweight priced into the size: the yen strengthened from the 160s at end-July (https://www.otakaraya.jp/platinum/pt-expert-archive/2026-08/), which trims translated overseas profit (36.5% of revenue).

findings.finding: FY26 itself is guided to land 'ガイダンス通り' (OP 3,650 / pretax 3,200 / NP 2,170) per the Q3 presentation, against an IFIS consensus of OP 3,800 / pretax 3,400 / NP 2,300 that has not moved in four weeks, so the year lands about 2-4% under the street number unless Q4 margin beats the 60-62% guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-16 Q3 profit decline (OP -22.8% in the quarter) fell 5.15%; the year was already reaffirmed then.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company said in July that the year lands on plan and the 進捗率 (OP 79.6%, pretax 81.4%) is computable by anyone, so the gap to a stale single-source consensus is visible. Left small for that reason.
findings.independence: Company statement in the Q3 presentation https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594356.pdf (p.24). Shares the margin document with the guidance finding; the platinum fall argues the other way on Q4, which is why this is near zero.

findings.finding: Share count rose ~2.7% around 2026-10-01 (Integral's unchanged 2,175,378 shares went from 24.87% to 24.22% purely on more shares outstanding), consistent with stock-option exercise, adding potential holder supply and diluting FY27 per-share figures.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 10-08 and already in diluted EPS (190.87 vs 201.00 basic at Q3), so largely priced; the residual is how the FY27 per-share guide reads.
findings.independence: Q3 tanshin diluted EPS 190.87 vs basic 201.00: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594146.pdf

outside_window.finding: A Murakami-group shareholder proposal or a going-private approach at or before the late-November AGM would be a separate, larger catalyst; nothing has been filed.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed; FY26 guided in line, IFIS 3,800 OP slightly above. Returns: FY26 dividend 120 yen (60 year-end) fixed; FY27 dividend guide and a possible buyback are the open item under Murakami pressure (payout policy 40%+). New-year guide: first FY27 guide due, MTP FY27 targets already exceeded, platinum cost relief vs stronger yen. Quarter vs own 進捗率: OP 79.6% / pretax 81.4% at Q3 vs 79.1% last year and 85.1% two years ago, so in the normal range.

rejected_candidates.candidate: July 2026 marriage registrations down ~32% y/y in the MHLW monthly table
rejected_candidates.detail: Seen only in a search summary with no explanation; the H1 cumulative series (+0.2%) from the same ministry contradicts a demand collapse and a July 2025 lucky-date base is the likely cause; ring purchases also precede registration.

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive against a flat priced lean (-0.12) and a small run-up (+2.4% 20d, -0.9% 5d), so they do not merely restate positioning; the strongest negative the release could carry is a conservative FY27 guide (yen strength, overseas investment) with no buyback, which is why p_up is only 60.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a series the market already has): the FY26-vs-IFIS gap rests on the company's own July 'in line' statement and a computable 進捗率, so it moved from -0.4 to -0.2; the option-dilution item, public since 10-08 and already in diluted EPS, moved from -0.2 to -0.1. p_up unchanged because it was set by the positives.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): checked; the set leans positive and baseline_tension names the strongest negative the release could carry. Nothing changed.
Positive findings (capital return +1.5, guidance +1.0) left standing.
